# gpn-mini-ledger
> A minimal GPN-style payment system demonstrating the layered priority stack (CP core ledger, AP edge switch, BASE async lane) with executable invariant tests.

- Author: Sai Likhith Kanuparthi
- GitHub: https://github.com/sailikhithk/gpn-mini-ledger
- Portfolio: https://sailikhith.me

## Core Concepts & Invariants
- Dual-entry ledger with balance isolation and idempotency guarantees.
- Strict SERIALIZABLE isolation level on PostgreSQL for zero double-spending anomalies.
- Testcontainers integration running concurrent stress tests with 100% automated assertion verification.
- Layered priority architecture separating low-latency ingestion, strict consistency accounting, and asynchronous settlement.

## Tech Stack
- Java 25 LTS, Spring Boot 4.1, PostgreSQL 16, Docker Compose, Testcontainers, Maven 3.9+
